repository.remoteMainAvailability: not present in this shallow Office3D snapshot; no ancestry claim is made

performance.measurementState: blocked: isolated runtime prerequisites are absent, so no fixed-device browser measurement is claimed

baseline.runtimeDifference: The isolated worktree intentionally lacks local operational configuration, so source and Node-level contracts are reproducible but browser evidence is blocked.

coordinates.unit: Three.js world units; x/z are the ground plane and y is up

contracts.registry: register(name, factory), buildAll(shared), onFrame(dt, context), activate(), deactivate(), dispose(); buildAll is idempotent and inactive or hidden roots do not receive frame updates.
contracts.canvasTexture: canvasTex(width, height, draw, repeat?, srgb?) invokes draw(ctx2d, width, height) exactly when creating the texture.
contracts.resourceOwnership: Each module disposes only its own textures, geometries, materials, timers, and listeners. Static batches retain semantic source IDs in userData.
contracts.outdoorIndoorBoundary: frontPlaza, parking, and logisticsGate are outdoor; visitor, showcase, dispatch, and officeMeeting are inside CAMPUS_BUILDING. The visitor threshold is the z=30 building edge and visitorHall/frontBridge are the stable walkable handoff IDs.

legacyReplacement.action: Not registered by dr-campus-modules.js in R1; Claude supplies a new private interior module before any replacement registration.
legacyReplacement.doubleBuildProtection: The total loader has no interior entry, so it cannot create a second floor, threshold, console, screen, label, or hotspot.

legacyReplacement.action: Selection specifications remain for stable IDs and bounds but do not render in the normal overview.
legacyReplacement.doubleBuildProtection: Private modules receive the same frozen layout and must use the stable zone IDs rather than add duplicate occupancy volumes.

usage.flags: Set office3d/campus-visual.json enabled=true and use ?campus=1. Missing, malformed, or non-boolean configuration remains off.

activeLocalRuntime.relationship: A separately running local service. Its working version is not assumed to equal this isolated integration candidate.
